summary: Verified the frontend fix with a production build and live end-to-end browser flow. Home, Nurse and Software Developer roadmap navigation, browser back, milestone expansion/collapse, mobile layout, and runtime error monitoring all passed.
seed_data_creation: None; static career data is intentional and no API calls are used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production build passed. Live preview flow passed at desktop and 390px mobile: Home -> Careers -> Nurse -> Roadmap -> back, Software Developer roadmap, milestone toggle, and overflow check. No pageerror or destroy cleanup error observed.
rca of the issue: The App.js mount effect now uses a block body and returns undefined after window.scrollTo, preventing React from treating a preview-specific scrollTo return object as an effect cleanup function. No recurrence observed.
